title: ASC 926 – Entertainment–Films
summary: Establishes accounting for film costs, participations, residuals, and revenue recognition based on the ultimate revenue estimation method.
description: ASC 926 covers capitalization of film costs, the individual-film-forecast method for amortization based on ultimate revenue estimates, participations and residuals, and impairment of film costs. It contrasts with IAS 38 and IAS 2 in several key areas.

bannerNotice.title: Divergence from IAS 38/IAS 2
bannerNotice.body: ASC 926's ultimate revenue estimation method and film cost capitalization diverge from IAS 38's intangible asset model. Differences also exist in the treatment of participations and residuals compared to IAS 2 inventory norms.
